title: Inalabs AI Platform
description: A business intelligence platform powered by machine learning, providing real-time data synthesis and autonomous forecasting for modern enterprises.

case_study.role: Full Lifecycle AI Engineering & UX Design
case_study.challenge: Modern leadership teams face decision fragmentation caused by disconnected data sources and sluggish reporting pipelines.
case_study.solution: Constructed an end-to-end multi-agent orchestration pipeline with vector database indexing, hybrid semantic search, and streaming analytics with sub-second latency.
results: Demonstrated 72% reduction in query resolution latency during benchmark testing
Implemented zero-leakage enterprise data partitioning with strict RLS
Built full streaming markdown parser with interactive artifact execution

title: Nexus Distributed Computing Node
description: High-frequency telemetry infrastructure and cloud analytics engine engineered for distributed operations and real-time observability.

case_study.challenge: High-density telemetry nodes required microsecond-accurate data ingestion without saturating network bandwidth or CPU overhead.
case_study.solution: Engineered a compiled Go stream processor with kernel-level zero-copy sockets and a minimalist dark terminal interface.
results: Sub-millisecond packet processing latency under peak simulated load
Zero downtime across rolling cluster updates
Single binary deployment with minimal memory footprint

title: Aura Neo-Banking OS
description: Cryptographic mobile interface and spatial transaction engine designed for biometric authentication and frictionless digital asset stewardship.

case_study.challenge: Conventional mobile banking interfaces are cluttered, slow, and lack sensory feedback for high-trust financial operations.
case_study.solution: Crafted a bespoke dark interface with hardware-backed secure enclave integration and instantaneous tactile transaction verification.
results: Sub-100ms app cold launch performance on both iOS and Android
Biometric secure enclave integration with zero plaintext credential caching
Personal finance AI categorizer running on on-device quantized models

title: OmniFlow Autonomous Supply Engine
description: Custom microservice software linking warehouse sensors, automated procurement, and predictive inventory analytics.

case_study.challenge: Unpredictable supply disruptions and fragmented legacy databases led to high carrying costs and periodic stock shortages.
case_study.solution: Constructed an event-driven microservice system with Apache Kafka, automated threshold triggers, and real-time shipment geolocation trackers.
results: Automated 80% of routine re-stock purchase order dispatches
Real-time reconciliation of multi-warehouse inventory across 12 distribution hubs
Fault-tolerant failover architecture with 99.99% simulated uptime

title: CyberShield Real-Time SOC Radar
description: Cybersecurity intelligence telemetry console detecting automated bot intrusions, zero-day threat patterns, and DDOS traffic anomalies in real time.

case_study.challenge: Security Operations Center (SOC) engineers were overwhelmed with tens of thousands of alerts per hour without clear prioritization.
case_study.solution: Designed an AI-assisted threat scoring matrix with 3D geographical node visualization and automated IP mitigation rules.
results: Compressed alert triage time from 15 minutes down to 45 seconds
Interactive dark radar visualization with WebGL globe rendering
Zero false-negative rate on standard MITRE ATT&CK test suites

title: PulseMed AI Diagnostics Assistant
description: Medical imaging computer vision pipeline providing physician co-pilot annotations, electronic medical record summaries, and appointment triage.

case_study.challenge: Radiologists review thousands of scans weekly, requiring assisted anomaly detection to minimize human fatigue errors.
case_study.solution: Deployed deep learning segmentation algorithms with DICOM viewer integration and privacy-preserving de-identification pipelines.
results: 96.2% validation sensitivity for identifying early pulmonary nodules in test data
Full HIPAA-compliant anonymization proxy for training data
Intuitive split-screen review console for clinicians

title: Veloce Headless Commerce Hub
description: Ultra-fast composable commerce platform with sub-second checkout, localized multi-currency pricing, and unified inventory across online & offline channels.

case_study.challenge: Legacy monolithic storefront had 4.8 second page load times, high cart abandonment, and difficult mobile usability.
case_study.solution: Rebuilt the frontend using Next.js ISR (Incremental Static Regeneration), edge-rendered product catalogs, and one-click payment flows.
results: Page load time reduced to 0.6 seconds globally on CDN edge
Conversion rate lift of +34% in A/B prototype testing
Seamless integration with Indonesian local payment gateways (QRIS, VA)

title: Kinetix Design System & Brand Identity
description: Comprehensive futuristic visual brand system, motion guidelines, typography tokens, and Figma UI kit tailored for modern AI & robotics startups.

case_study.challenge: New hardware/software deep tech venture lacked a recognizable visual identity that conveyed cutting-edge precision and trust.
case_study.solution: Crafted a bespoke mathematical logo grid, dynamic dark-mode palette, custom iconography, and interactive tokenized web component library.
results: Delivered 120+ modular Figma components synced to Tailwind CSS tokens
Standardized enterprise branding collateral across web, pitch deck, and merchandise
Seamless brand translation into high-performance web experiences
